rationale.mapping_notes: Tokens are the tuff palette copied verbatim per variant, with no re-derivation. --gradient is a 135-degree linear-gradient across the core's three stops for that variant, which run ochre to Roman red on the short hue path. Type tokens carry the artefact's own trio: Instrument Serif for display, Newsreader for body and Barlow Condensed in the mono slot, which is a deliberate substitution because the artefact uses a condensed sans for labels and small caps rather than any monospace face; nothing in the piece sets code. Shape tokens keep small radii (2/4/8 px) because the chart's panels and buttons are close to square in the original and rounder corners would soften a deliberately architectural layout.

type.--font-display: 'Instrument Serif', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif
type.--font-body: 'Newsreader', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Charter, Georgia, serif
type.--font-mono: 'Barlow Condensed', 'Avenir Next Condensed', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

html.theme_switch: data-theme attribute on :root plus prefers-color-scheme fallback (see artefact-conventions)
